name: Onesimus
bio: Onesimus, called a faithful and beloved brother by Paul, was sent along with Tychicus to inform the Colossian church of Paul's circumstances (Colossians 4:9). He was a slave who had run away from his master Philemon and come to faith through Paul while the apostle was imprisoned; Paul sent him back to Philemon with a personal letter asking that he be received not as a slave but as a beloved brother, offering to cover any debt Onesimus owed (the Epistle to Philemon).
